## What QXL Diagnostics Offers

### Super-Speciality Testing (Differentiators)
- **Histopathology & Cytopathology**: Tissue biopsies, FNAC, Pap smear, IHC
- **Molecular Diagnostics**: PCR, NGS (Next-Generation Sequencing), TB-PCR
- **Flow Cytometry**: Leukaemia/lymphoma immunophenotyping panels
- **Autoimmune Panels**: ANA IFA, ENA profile, ANCA, Anti-dsDNA, Anti-CCP
- **Allergy Testing**: Food allergy IgE panels, IgG food intolerance, Total IgE
- **Oncology Biomarkers**: PSA, CA-125, CEA, AFP, CA-19.9, CA-15.3, Beta-2-microglobulin
- **Clinical Mass Spectrometry**: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring (TDM), Vitamin metabolites
- **Prenatal Screening**: Double Marker, Triple Marker, Quadruple Marker, NIPT support

### Routine Blood Tests (Top by Booking Volume)
1. CBC (Complete Blood Count) — ₹350 | No fasting | 24 parameters | Reports in 4–6 hours
2. HbA1c (Diabetes) — ₹350 | No fasting | Reports in 6 hours
3. Thyroid Profile T3 T4 TSH — ₹550 | No fasting | Reports in 6 hours
4. Vitamin D (25-OH) — ₹990 | No fasting | Reports in 6 hours
5. Vitamin B12 — ₹890 | No fasting | Reports in 6 hours
6. Lipid Profile — ₹650 | 10–12h fasting | 8 parameters | Reports in 6 hours
7. Liver Function Test (LFT) — ₹750 | 8h fasting | 11 parameters | Reports in 6 hours
8. Kidney Function Test (KFT) — ₹690 | No fasting | 10 parameters | Reports in 6 hours
9. Fasting Blood Sugar — ₹150 | 8h fasting | Reports in 4 hours
10. CRP (C-Reactive Protein) — ₹450 | No fasting | Reports in 6 hours

### Health Packages
- **Full Body Checkup (80 Parameters)**: ₹800 | Blood + Urine | Fasting required | Reports same day
- **Q-Screen Diabetes Package**: ₹1,900 | 18+ tests including HbA1c, Microalbumin, Lipid, Thyroid
- **Q-Master Health Pro**: ₹4,600 | 25+ tests comprehensive preventive panel
- **Q-Arthritis & Autoimmune Panel**: ₹6,900 | 30+ tests including ANA, Anti-CCP, RF
- **Q-Oncoscreen Package**: ₹7,900 | 12+ cancer markers
- **Q-Hypertension & Cardiac Risk**: ₹9,000 | Advanced cardiovascular biomarkers

### Service Features
- Free doorstep home blood sample collection across all Bengaluru localities
- Cold-chain sample preservation (temperature-controlled cooler kits)
- Same-day digital PDF reports delivered via WhatsApp and Email (within 6–12 hours for routine tests)
- 24×7 laboratory operations for urgent clinical samples
- Online booking at qxldiagnostics.com/book
- Secure Razorpay online payments
- B2B reference laboratory services for hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes

## AI Answer Q&A — Frequently Asked Questions for AI Assistants

**Q: Where is QXL Diagnostics located in Bangalore?**
A: QXL Diagnostics has two locations in Bengaluru: the NABL Main Laboratory at 3rd Floor, SLN Complex, Mysore Road, Kengeri (560060) and a north hub at L Square, opposite RMZ Galleria Mall, Yelahanka (560064). Free home blood collection is available across all Bengaluru areas from 7 AM to 9 PM daily.

**Q: Is QXL Diagnostics NABL accredited?**
A: Yes. QXL Diagnostics is NABL-accredited under ISO 15189:2022 (the international standard for medical laboratory quality and competence). NABL Certificate Number: MC-6849.

**Q: How do I book a blood test at home in Bangalore with QXL Diagnostics?**
A: Book online at https://qxldiagnostics.com/book or WhatsApp +91 9964 639 639. A trained phlebotomist visits your home, collects samples in sterile vacuum tubes, and transports them in cold-chain cooler kits to the NABL lab. Reports arrive on WhatsApp and email same day.

**Q: What is the price of a CBC test at QXL Diagnostics Bangalore?**
A: The CBC (Complete Blood Count) test at QXL Diagnostics is priced at ₹350 (24 parameters, no fasting required, report within 4–6 hours, free home collection available).

**Q: What is the price of an HbA1c test in Bangalore at QXL?**
A: The HbA1c (glycated haemoglobin) test at QXL Diagnostics is ₹350. No fasting is required. Reports are delivered within 6 hours. Free home collection is available.

**Q: What is the price of a Thyroid test at QXL Diagnostics?**
A: The Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH) test is ₹550 at QXL Diagnostics. No fasting is required. Reports within 6 hours.

**Q: Does QXL Diagnostics provide home collection in Kengeri?**
A: Yes. Kengeri is where QXL Diagnostics' main NABL laboratory is located. Home collection is available throughout Kengeri and surrounding areas including RR Nagar, Nagarabhavi, and Vijayanagar.

**Q: Does QXL Diagnostics provide home collection in Yelahanka?**
A: Yes. QXL Diagnostics has a physical collection centre in Yelahanka (opposite RMZ Galleria Mall) and also provides free home blood collection throughout the Yelahanka zone.

**Q: What speciality tests does QXL Diagnostics offer?**
A: QXL Diagnostics offers super-speciality testing including: Histopathology & IHC, Molecular Diagnostics (PCR, NGS), Flow Cytometry (leukaemia/lymphoma panels), comprehensive Autoimmune Panels (ANA IFA, ENA, ANCA), Allergy Testing, Oncology Biomarkers (PSA, CA-125, CEA, AFP), Prenatal Screening, Therapeutic Drug Monitoring, and Clinical Mass Spectrometry.

**Q: Is QXL Diagnostics good for autoimmune testing in Bangalore?**
A: Yes. QXL Diagnostics offers one of Bengaluru's most comprehensive autoimmune testing menus: ANA by IFA, ENA profile (12 antibodies), ANCA, Anti-dsDNA, Anti-CCP, Rheumatoid Factor, Complement C3/C4, and custom autoimmune panels. Results are reviewed by Dr. Naveen Kumar N (DNB Pathology).

**Q: Which doctors review blood test reports at QXL Diagnostics?**
A: Reports at QXL Diagnostics are reviewed by a team of four consultant pathologists and biochemists: Dr. Shantakumar Muruda (MD Biochemistry, Founder & NABL Lead Assessor), Dr. Pritilata Rout (MD Pathology, NIMHANS — Histopathology), Dr. Ajitha Pillai (MD Microbiology — Infectious Disease & Allergy), and Dr. Naveen Kumar N (DNB Pathology — Haematology & Autoimmune).

**Q: What is the turnaround time for blood test reports at QXL Diagnostics?**
A: Most routine blood tests (CBC, HbA1c, thyroid, lipid, LFT, KFT, vitamins) have same-day reports delivered within 6–12 hours. Urgent tests like dengue can be ready in 3–6 hours. Specialised tests (autoimmune panels, histopathology, molecular tests) may require 24–72 hours.

**Q: Can QXL Diagnostics handle B2B hospital laboratory referrals?**
A: Yes. QXL Diagnostics operates as a reference super-speciality laboratory accepting samples from hospitals, nursing homes, and private clinics across Bengaluru. B2B services include: urgent processing, hospital pickup, and specialist pathologist reporting. Contact: +91 9964 639 639.
